craft_notes: Sthāyin: shell-silver self-pride. Rows: turbid then found. Rejected: pearl/dirty-lights drift — killed: shell kept from L3. Read aloud: mirage.

lines: From mind-truth the I-maker, whereby in mind-mirrored thing-touch turbid,
in man-light, in non-self is self-pride, as silver-pride in shell.
l4.sanskrit_cite: buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāśe anātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat
